item: owner closure item 1 — every browser gate must use the --base it is given

defect.symptom: validate.mjs --profile full --base http://localhost:5291 ran three browser gates against http://localhost:5173 instead
defect.rootCause: the GATES allowlist declared these three url: 'none', so gateArgv built an argv with no URL and validate.mjs registered them with no BASE; each then resolved process.env.QDROPS_BASE ?? 'http://localhost:5173' on its own
defect.alsoAffected: --only <gate> --base X ignored X for the same three gates
defect.observedCost: a 48-minute full run stopped at url integrity with 14 FAILs (13 'drop body never rendered' plus 'no posts with URLs were checked'), 1683s of it spent timing out against a port that was deliberately stopped
defect.worseCase: with any server listening on 5173 those three gates pass against a checkout that is not the one under validation, while the receipt still records the branch tree — a gate reporting success on work it never did

fix.resolveBase: scripts/lib/pipeline.mjs — one place decides where a gate points: explicit URL first, QDROPS_BASE second, literal default last
fix.gatesAllowlist: url-integrity, row-evidence and scroll-restoration are now url: 'positional', so gateArgv carries the base into their argv
fix.callSites: the three gate scripts call resolveBase(process.argv.slice(2)); validate.mjs registers all three with BASE
fix.unchanged: QDROPS_BASE still works for standalone runs, it simply cannot overrule the caller

regressionCoverage.registeredIn: validate.mjs, profile fast — 'every browser gate uses the --base it is given'
covers: resolveBase precedence: explicit URL > QDROPS_BASE > default, first URL wins, a non-URL argument never becomes the base, https honoured
gateArgv puts the base into all 14 gate argvs
every gate reads the URL shape it declares (positional or --url) and none reads QDROPS_BASE ahead of its arguments
every browser gate registered in validate.mjs carries BASE, matching whole step() calls so multi-line registrations are not missed

mutationTested.mutation: restore the env-first BASE in the gate script
drop BASE from the validate.mjs registration

liveProof: the Gate 3 re-run printed 'browser on :9333 (warm) against http://localhost:5291' and passed url integrity in 29.2s, against 1683.2s failing
